# Inkloom 0.225.0 Debug verification

Source: `baa77c42d3eb83fede723598a3ea7d87c128256d`. APK SHA-256: `30c585fef434ebe802297209123665eb619ca1d76320c8aa73faa41e0e73f578`.

- Reference/draft folders: nested descendants inherit flags without rewriting their own metadata. Group buttons and menus are enabled; toggles use scoped chronological history, preserve unrelated edits and persist across recreation. Obsolete direct-write flag entry points removed.
- Draft reference exclusion: Fill/automatic selection Tool property switch, enabled by default; disabled setting includes sketch reference boundaries. Preferences and backup round-trip tested; older settings retain exclusion. Eyedropper reference folders inherit reference flags.
- Ordinary RGBA8/F16 composite output and merge-visible exclude nested draft folders; editor element rendering retains sketches. Explicit selected/downward merge, transfer and apply-mask retain selected draft pixels instead of treating the edit as an export. Third-party layered file draft metadata compatibility is not claimed complete.
- Selection stroke: inside/center/outside, 0.25-256 px, standard RGB/ARGB picker and opacity. Uses the half-coverage contour of the selection, including holes/islands, scaled masks and tile seams. Cancellable bounded tile/halo distance computation; sparse 8K perimeter coverage tested. Cancel leaves pixels unchanged; apply preserves selection and uses one undo/redo; exact pixels after reopening verified. Locked and mask-edit targets rejected. Keyboard insets and Done actions keep dialog confirmation usable.
- Paste to shown position: selection menu and Ctrl+Shift+V. Inverse viewport geometry handles scale, pan and rotation; oversized/off-page payloads remain clipped to an accessible page edge. Pixel and selection changes undo/redo together, original feather state restored. Native RGBA8/F16 format conversion and alpha-lock compositing tested. This edits the active raster layer; retained vector/text/new-layer paste semantics are not claimed.
- Transparent Android image clipboard: straight Bitmap ARGB correctly converts to/from premultiplied engine pixels, preserving half-transparent color. External text clipboard cannot resurrect a cached image. Same native F16 payload retains precision without PNG re-decoding.
- UI test isolation: clear test-only notebook checkpoints, recovery journal and folder index together. Previous same-title fixtures accidentally reopened another note; isolated exact-payload reopen tests now pass. No user-data cleanup is introduced in production.

1010 JVM tests: 0 failures, 8 skipped. 49 unique relevant Android 15 cases passed across final runs: 48 draft export, layer group rendering, fill, settings and merge cases; one real folder-button, inheritance, undo/redo and recreation test. That window test passed again after history integration. Selection/clipboard additions passed 64 targeted cases on 0.224.0 before folder changes; this release does not claim a new full selection-suite run. Final lint evidence is recorded in the adjacent JSON.

No full Android-suite success is claimed. MovinkPad touch, pressure, latency and long-session validation remain DEVICE_PENDING. Engine 8K cases do not prove device production performance. Drive Desktop local four-file hashes are checked during delivery; cloud redownload is unverified. Requirements/design/task documents remain ignored. Deferred or scope-undecided CSP extensions are not claimed implemented.
